stored_text.note: official.html is AGESIC's gub.uy publication page for the strategy (title, date 22/11/2024, approval on 21 November 2024, the three specific objectives, the Article 74 basis). The strategy document itself, linked from that page, is not stored. secondary.html is IMPO's text of Article 74 of Ley 20.212. Both in Spanish.

english_version.note: No English text in the stored files. One web search found English overviews by OECD.AI, a news site and a tracker, and only Spanish AGESIC pages; no English version of the strategy.

title.why: original_title matches the page title except that the page puts spaces around the dash. The English is a literal and correct rendering.

summary_claims.claim: Its first objective is governance: an institutional and regulatory framework for ethical, responsible and safe AI with clear rules, transparency, security and legal certainty.
summary_claims.locator: publication page, list of specific objectives
summary_claims.original_quote: Gobernanza: establecer un marco de gobernanza que garantice el desarrollo y uso ético, responsable y seguro de la IA, asegurando una institucionalidad adecuada, marcos regulatorios claros y procesos eficientes que promuevan la transparencia, la seguridad, la inclusión y la seguridad jurídica
summary_claims.literal_translation: Governance: establish a governance framework that guarantees the ethical, responsible and safe development and use of AI, ensuring adequate institutions, clear regulatory frameworks and efficient processes that promote transparency, security, inclusion and legal certainty

summary_claims.claim: It was developed under Art. 74 of Law 20.212.
summary_claims.locator: publication page, paragraph on the revision process
summary_claims.original_quote: fue liderado y articulado por Agesic, en coordinación con el Comité Estratégico del Sector Público para la Inteligencia Artificial y Datos, de acuerdo con lo establecido en el artículo 74 de la Ley N° 20.212 de 6 de noviembre de 2023.
summary_claims.literal_translation: [The process of revising the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy] was led and coordinated by Agesic, in coordination with the Public Sector Strategic Committee for Artificial Intelligence and Data, in accordance with Article 74 of Law No. 20.212 of 6 November 2023.

summary_claims.claim: Developed together with an AGESIC report on recommendations for AI regulation.
summary_claims.original_quote: Como parte de esta estrategia nacional de inteligencia artificial, se establece un plazo de ciento ochenta días para la presentación ante el Poder Legislativo de un informe y recomendaciones para su regulación legal
summary_claims.literal_translation: As part of this national artificial intelligence strategy, a period of one hundred and eighty days is set for the submission to the Legislative Branch of a report and recommendations for its legal regulation

key_terms.original: Comité Estratégico del Sector Público para la Inteligencia Artificial y Datos
key_terms.register_rendering: Public Sector Strategic Committee for AI and Data

key_terms.original: uso ético, responsable y seguro de la IA
key_terms.note: 'seguro' rendered 'safe'; 'la seguridad' in the same sentence rendered 'security'. Both are possible senses of the Spanish and the choice is reasonable.

key_terms.original: Informe sobre recomendaciones para una regulación de la inteligencia artificial
key_terms.register_rendering: AGESIC report on recommendations for AI regulation
key_terms.note: The publication page links the report under this name; Article 74 requires it to go to the Legislative Branch within 180 days.

note: The governance objective also lists 'inclusion' (la inclusión), which the summary leaves out; that is a choice of emphasis, not an error. The notes' dates (approved 21 November 2024, published 22 November 2024) match the stored page. The strategy document itself is not stored, so the record's content rests on AGESIC's description of it; storing the strategy PDF would let a later check read the document.
